h1. Oracle SYS Password Rotation  -  Playbook Reference

{panel:title=At a Glance|borderColor=#0B7A75|titleBGColor=#E6F4F3|borderWidth=2}
*Playbook:* {{sys_password_rotation/main.yml}}
*Role:* {{rotate_password}}  (generic  -  always called with {{target_user: "SYS"}} by this playbook)
*Vault engine:* Custom static database secrets engine ({{vault-plugin-static-database}})
*Scope:* Automated SYS password rotation across an ExaCC estate
{panel}

----

h2. Objective

Discovers which Oracle SYS credentials in HashiCorp Vault are overdue for rotation, confirms live Data Guard topology before touching anything, rotates only confirmed PRIMARY databases, and publishes a structured end-of-run report to AAP Artifacts.

*Key design principles:*
* Standbys are explicitly excluded at Phase 1.5  -  the live topology check  -  so no serial setting can accidentally rotate a standby
* SYS password propagation to DG standbys uses the native ExaCC blob mechanism ({{--prepareStandbyBlob}} / {{--standbyBlobFromPrimary}})
* All Vault API calls in Phase 1 are bounded by {{vault_api_concurrency}} to protect the Vault cluster
* Each rotation attempt runs inside a {{block/rescue}} in the role  -  failure on one database does not abort the estate

----

h2. Architecture

|| Phase || Hosts || What happens ||
| *Phase 1* | localhost | Vault auth -> list all {{SYS_*_EXACC}} roles -> parallel metadata reads (throttled) -> fetch credentials for overdue candidates -> build {{_verify_candidates}} in-memory inventory |
| *Phase 1.5* | _verify_candidates | Live {{dbaascli database getDetails}} on every overdue candidate. Confirm PRIMARY vs STANDBY. Only confirmed PRIMARYs enter {{rotation_targets}}. |
| *Phase 2* | rotation_targets | Execute {{rotate_password}} role (serial, DG-safe). Role performs 11 phases from Vault pre-check through post-validation. |
| *Phase 3* | localhost | Aggregate {{rotation_summary}} and {{rotation_failures}} from localhost hostvars -> {{set_stats}} -> AAP Artifacts report |

{info:title=Job Slicing must be 1}
Do *not* slice this job. Slicing creates independent child jobs, each with its own isolated hostvars state. The {{delegate_facts: true}} aggregation pattern used across plays produces N incomplete summaries instead of one consolidated report. Control parallelism with {{rotation_serial}} and {{forks}} instead.
{info}

----

h2. Prerequisites

h3. Environment Variables

Set on the AAP execution environment or job template:

|| Variable || Description ||
| {{_CLIENT__HASHI_URL}} | HashiCorp Vault base URL (e.g. {{https://vault.example.com:8200}}) |
| {{_CLIENT__HASHI_NAMESPACE}} | Vault namespace ({{X-Vault-Namespace}} header value) |
| {{_CLIENT__HASHI_ROLE}} | Vault role name used for OTP SSH authentication |

h3. Vault Requirements

* Custom static database secrets engine mounted at {{secrets/static-database}}
* Roles named {{SYS_<DB_UNIQUE_NAME>_EXACC}} (uppercase, underscore-delimited)
* {{/role/{name}}} endpoint returns: {{username}}, {{created_at}}, {{current_version}}
* {{/cred/{name}}} endpoint returns: {{password}}, {{connection_url}} (comma-separated ExaCC node FQDNs)
* Token obtained via {{lookup('_client_.epe.hashi_vault_login_token', token_ttl='6h')}}

h3. Target Host Requirements

* {{ans_oracle}} SSH account with OTP auth via Vault
* {{oracle}} OS account reachable via {{su}} from {{ans_oracle}}
* {{dbaascli}} present at {{/bin/dbaascli}}
* Per-database environment files at {{/home/oracle/<db_unique_name>.env}}
* {{breakglass_backup_path}} directory writable by root (default: {{/etc/oracle/breakglass}})

----

h2. Inputs

h3. Extra Variables

|| Variable || Default || Description ||
| {{target_user}} | {{SYS}} | Oracle account to rotate. Always passed as {{SYS}} by this playbook; the role is generic. |
| {{password_max_age_days}} | {{90}} | Rotate if credential age exceeds this threshold (days) |
| {{password_min_age_days}} | {{1}} | Skip if credential was rotated more recently than this (guards against double-rotation) |
| {{rotation_serial}} | {{1}} | Phase 2 parallelism  -  integer or percentage (e.g. {{"10%"}}) |
| {{rotation_max_fail_pct}} | {{100}} | Abort Phase 2 if this percentage of hosts fail |
| {{verify_serial}} | {{10}} | Phase 1.5 parallelism  -  concurrent dbaascli topology checks |
| {{vault_api_concurrency}} | {{25}} | Max simultaneous Vault API calls during Phase 1 discovery |
| {{vault_engine_mount}} | {{secrets/static-database}} | Vault engine mount point |
| {{environment}} | {{prod}} | Stamped on host records for reporting |

h3. Vault Role Name Convention

{code}
SYS_<DB_UNIQUE_NAME>_EXACC
{code}

Phase 1 lists all roles and filters to those matching {{^SYS_.*_EXACC$}}. The {{rotate_password}} role is then called with {{target_user: "SYS"}} set explicitly.

----

h2. Outputs

h3. AAP Artifacts (set_stats)

A {{rotation_report}} dict is published at the end of the run and captured automatically by AAP:

{code:language=json}
{
  "rotation_report": {
    "run_at": "2026-01-15T09:30:00Z",
    "target_user": "SYS",
    "password_max_age_days": 90,
    "totals": {
      "rotated": 12,
      "skipped": 3,
      "failed": 0,
      "excluded": 2
    },
    "rotated": {
      "DBPROD01": {
        "status": "ROTATED",
        "host": "exacc-node1.example.com",
        "vault_role": "SYS_DBPROD01_EXACC",
        "db_role": "PRIMARY",
        "dg": true,
        "commvault": false,
        "secret_age": 94.3
      }
    },
    "skipped": {
      "DBPROD02": { "status": "SKIPPED", "secret_age": 45.1 }
    },
    "failed":   {},
    "excluded": ["DBDR01", "DBDR02"]
  }
}
{code}

|| Key || Meaning ||
| {{rotated}} | Databases where the credential was changed this run |
| {{skipped}} | Databases not yet due ({{secret_age < password_max_age_days}}) |
| {{failed}} | Databases where the role execution failed  -  includes {{failed_task}} name and {{error}} message |
| {{excluded}} | Databases that did not pass Phase 1.5 verification (STANDBY, UNKNOWN, or unreachable) |

h3. Console Summary

Printed at the end of every run:

{code}
ROTATED  : 12
SKIPPED  :  3
FAILED   :  0
EXCLUDED :  2  (Phase 1.5  -  not PRIMARY or unreachable)
{code}

----

h2. Sequence Diagram

{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant AAP as AAP / Controller
    participant Vault as HashiCorp Vault
    participant ExaCC as ExaCC Node (dbaascli)
    participant Oracle as Oracle DB (sqlplus)

    rect rgb(230, 240, 255)
        Note over AAP,Vault: Phase 1  -  Discovery (localhost)
        AAP->>Vault: Authenticate  -  custom login plugin (TTL=6h)
        Vault-->>AAP: login_token
        AAP->>Vault: GET /role?list=true
        Vault-->>AAP: All role names
        AAP->>AAP: Filter to SYS_*_EXACC, compute age vs threshold
        AAP->>Vault: GET /role/{name} x N (async, throttled by vault_api_concurrency)
        Vault-->>AAP: created_at, current_version per role
        AAP->>Vault: GET /cred/{name} x overdue candidates (async, throttled)
        Vault-->>AAP: password, connection_url per overdue role
        AAP->>AAP: Build _verify_candidates in-memory inventory
    end

    rect rgb(230, 255, 230)
        Note over AAP,ExaCC: Phase 1.5  -  Live Topology Verification
        loop Each candidate (serial: verify_serial)
            AAP->>Vault: OTP SSH lookup (ans_oracle + oracle)
            AAP->>ExaCC: SSH -> dbaascli database getDetails --dbname
            ExaCC-->>AAP: JSON -- dbRole, SCAN, PDB list
            alt dbRole == PRIMARY
                AAP->>AAP: Add to rotation_targets
            else STANDBY or UNKNOWN
                AAP->>AAP: Exclude with warning
            end
        end
    end

    rect rgb(255, 245, 230)
        Note over AAP,Oracle: Phase 2  -  Rotation (serial: rotation_serial)
        loop Each confirmed PRIMARY
            AAP->>Vault: OTP SSH lookup (ans_oracle + oracle)
            AAP->>ExaCC: SSH -> rotate_password role (11 phases)
            Note over ExaCC,Oracle: See role sequence diagram
            ExaCC->>Oracle: Validate current credential (sqlplus)
            ExaCC->>ExaCC: Write break-glass backup (chmod 0600)
            ExaCC->>ExaCC: dbaascli changePassword --user SYS
            ExaCC->>Oracle: Verify new credential (sqlplus)
            ExaCC->>Vault: POST /role/SYS_{name}_EXACC
            Vault-->>ExaCC: 200 OK -- version incremented
            ExaCC->>ExaCC: Delete break-glass backup
            AAP->>AAP: Record ROTATED / SKIPPED to localhost hostvars
        end
    end

    rect rgb(245, 230, 255)
        Note over AAP: Phase 3  -  Summary (localhost)
        AAP->>AAP: Aggregate rotation_summary + rotation_failures
        AAP->>AAP: set_stats -> rotation_report (AAP Artifacts)
        AAP->>AAP: Print ROTATED / SKIPPED / FAILED / EXCLUDED totals
    end
{mermaid}

{note:title=Mermaid Plugin Required}
The diagram above requires the *Mermaid Diagrams for Confluence* app (Atlassian Marketplace). If the plugin is not installed, change the opening {{{{mermaid}}}} tag to {{{{code:language=mermaid}}}} and the closing tag accordingly  -  it will render as a syntax-highlighted code block.
{note}

h2. Usage

h3. AAP Job Template Settings

|| Setting || Value ||
| Playbook | {{sys_password_rotation/main.yml}} |
| Forks | {{20}} (scale to estate size) |
| Job Slicing | *1*  -  do not slice |

h3. Extra Variables in AAP (JSON format)

{code:language=json}
{
  "environment": "prod",
  "password_max_age_days": 90,
  "rotation_serial": "10%",
  "vault_api_concurrency": 25
}
{code}

h3. CLI Examples

{code:language=bash|title=Standard run}
ansible-playbook sys_password_rotation/main.yml -e environment=prod
{code}

{code:language=bash|title=Large estate  -  10% parallelism, 20 forks}
ansible-playbook sys_password_rotation/main.yml -e environment=prod -e rotation_serial="10%" -f 20
{code}

{code:language=bash|title=Force rotation of all roles regardless of age}
ansible-playbook sys_password_rotation/main.yml -e password_max_age_days=0
{code}

{code:language=bash|title=Abort only if more than 50% of hosts fail}
ansible-playbook sys_password_rotation/main.yml -e rotation_max_fail_pct=50
{code}

----

h2. Security Notes

{warning:title=Credential Handling}
* The Vault login token is obtained once per run and held in memory only ({{no_log: true}} throughout all tasks that touch it)
* Current and new credentials are *never* written to logs
* Break-glass files are {{chmod 0600}}, root-owned, and deleted from the target host only after Vault write-back is confirmed
* If rotation fails after Phase 8 (credential changed in Oracle but Vault write failed), the break-glass file intentionally remains for manual recovery
{warning}

* Standbys are excluded at Phase 1.5  -  the {{rotation_serial}} value cannot inadvertently reach a standby node
* OTP SSH credentials are session-scoped (no reuse) and fetched per-batch immediately before the SSH connection is opened
* SSH ControlMaster ({{ControlPersist=60s}}) reduces OTP lookups on clusters with multiple databases  -  one OTP per physical host, not one per database
